definition: full of strong anger about the past
description: On an athletics podium on the grass of a floodlit stadium at dusk, a young woman in a navy crop top and briefs, her long braids in a ponytail, stands on the lower step with her arms crossed and a silver medal on her chest, scowling and looking away. On the higher step a young woman in white smiles and raises a gold medal high above her head, holding a bouquet. The view moves closer to the scowling woman until her angry face fills most of the view. Empty stands and bright floodlights are behind.

en.question: How does the woman in blue feel?

de.answer: Sie ist verbittert über ihre Silbermedaille.
de.question: Wie fühlt sich die Frau in Blau?

es.answer: Se siente resentida por su medalla de plata.
es.question: ¿Cómo se siente la mujer de azul?

fr.answer: Elle est amère à cause de sa médaille d'argent.
fr.question: Comment se sent la femme en bleu ?
